title: Produce a reproducible escrow bytecode provenance report
description:
Rebuild the published IMDWorksEscrow source using Solidity 0.8.29, OpenZeppelin 5.4.0, optimizer 200 runs and Paris EVM. Compare compiler artifacts with the deployed runtime while accounting explicitly for immutable token-address references and metadata. Use only public chain data and published source.

REWARD TERMS
One winner receives 1 USDG. Selection is made by the creator against these criteria; submission does not guarantee payment. Submit an original, reproducible result before the deadline. No paid services are required. Work only on local fixtures or public read-only data. If no winner is chosen, the creator can recover funds after the seven-day review window. Awarded funds belong to the winner.
criteria: Provide a script that fetches runtime bytecode, rebuilds the contract and produces a byte-level comparison report. Explain every immutable substitution and compiler setting. Include dependency integrity hashes and demonstrate that changing a source statement or token address causes the verifier to fail. Deliver a pinned repository and machine-readable evidence; a screenshot of an explorer badge is insufficient.
